═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📥 FIRST TIME SETUP (Do Once)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  1. Extract skill package to:
     C:\source\MD\AdminTools\.github\skills\outlook-email-extraction\

  2. Right-click → Run as Administrator:
     Install-Dependencies.bat
     
     ⏱ Takes ~5 minutes
     ✅ Installs Azure CLI, ADO extension, PowerShell modules

  3. Login when prompted (browser opens)
     ✅ Azure account
     ✅ Microsoft Graph consent

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🚀 REGULAR USE (Anytime - DRAG AND DROP)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  1. Create a folder ANYWHERE you want:
     Desktop, Downloads, Documents, etc.

  2. Save email as .eml file:
     Outlook → File → Save As → .eml format

  3. Drop .eml files into your folder

  4. Invoke via your AI assistant WITH FOLDER PATH:
     
     Claude Desktop:
     "process the emails from C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\email-folder"
     
     GitHub Copilot:
     "@workspace process the emails from C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\email-folder"
     
     Replace "YourName" and "email-folder" with your actual paths

  5. Wait for automation:
     ✅ Email parsed
     ✅ Screenshots analyzed
     ✅ Issue investigated
     ✅ Time estimated
     ✅ ADO work item created
     ✅ Assigned to you
     ✅ Email archived (Archive\ subfolder auto-created)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📁 FOLDER STRUCTURE (DRAG AND DROP - YOU CHOOSE!)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Create folder ANYWHERE:
  C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\email-to-ado\       ← Your chosen location
  C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\email-to-ado\Archive\ ← Auto-created

  Example locations:
  - Desktop: C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\emails\
  - Downloads: C:\Users\YourName\Downloads\support-emails\
  - Documents: C:\Users\YourName\Documents\work-items\
  - Anywhere you want!

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 WHAT IT DOES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  1. Setup folders           (if not exist)
  2. Parse email             (sender, subject, body, attachments)
  3. Analyze screenshots     (AI vision extraction)
  4. Investigate issue       (database queries, log analysis)
  5. Classify type           (Bug or Task)
  6. Estimate time           (2h simple, 4h moderate, 8h complex)
  7. Create ADO work item    (with all context)
  8. Assign to you           (auto-detected from $env:USERNAME)
  9. Archive email           (moves to Archive folder)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔍 EMAIL TO USER STORY MAPPING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Keywords in Email → User Story Assigned
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  price, vendor, MarkIt, ICE, LSEG      → #85755 Pricing Issues
  balance, cash, reconciliation         → #85756 Cash Reconciliation
  Solvas, normalization, seniority      → #85757 Data Normalization
  new fund, portfolio setup             → #85758 Portfolio Setup
  duplicate, missing identifier         → #85759 Data Quality
  slow query, timeout, performance      → #85760 Performance
  SSIS, package failure, ETL            → #85761 SSIS Errors
  import file, vendor file              → #85762 Import Files
  (no match)                            → #85799 General MOS Support

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🐛 BUG vs TASK CLASSIFICATION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Creates BUG when:
  - Keywords: broken, error, failing, incorrect, blank, missing
  - Screenshots show: error messages, blank fields, discrepancies
  - Investigation finds: data corruption, system failures

  Creates TASK when:
  - Keywords: setup, configure, new fund, enhancement
  - Work involves: configuration, new features, investigations

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ⏱ TIME ESTIMATES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  2 hours  - Simple fixes, single system, clear root cause
  4 hours  - Moderate complexity, multiple data sources
  8 hours  - Complex investigation, many systems, unclear cause

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🆘 TROUBLESHOOTING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  "No emails found"
  → Put .eml files in C:\source\Outlook\emails\ (not Archive)

  "Azure CLI not found"
  → Re-run Install-Dependencies.bat as Administrator

  "@Mossy not found"
  → Copy AGENTS.md to .github/agents/ and restart VS Code

  "Can't create work item"
  → Check: az devops project show --project Siepe.Software

  "Can't access emails"
  → Run: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Mail.Read

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔑 COMMANDS REFERENCE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Check Azure login:
  az account show

  Check ADO config:
  az devops configure --list

  Test ADO access:
  az devops project show --project Siepe.Software

  Re-login Azure:
  az login

  Check email access:
  Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Mail.Read

  View processed emails:
  Get-ChildItem C:\source\Outlook\emails\Archive\
